name: Inamorata
source:
Ever wanted a hot vampire girlfriend, but you’re too asexual for your own good? 

Play as Ronnie, the swoon-worthy, buff heroine of this comfy, cozy visual novel, and see if you can win over the stylish and beautiful Cece.

Other characters include and are limited to: Best friend Izzy, the non-BEARnary wonder, and their suspiciously pale and sharp-toothed authentic Italian boyfriend KC. 

[From [url=https://demeru.itch.io/inamorata]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
曾经想要一个性感的吸血鬼女朋友，但你太无性了？

扮演罗尼，这部舒适温馨的视觉小说中令人着迷、皮肤黝黑的女主角，看看你是否能赢得时尚美丽的西西的芳心。

其他角色包括且仅限于：最好的朋友Izzy，非BEARnary的奇迹，以及他们苍白、牙齿锋利的正宗意大利男友KC。

[来自[url=https://demeru.itch.io/inamorata]itch.io[/url]]
